author: ANN

title: 10 Years Later, Classic Shonen Jump Series Returns With a New Release
content: One classic from the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is getting a new anime 50 years after its debut, and the first look at the new project has been revealed. Shueisha has a lot to celebrate this weekend as the annual Jump Festa 2026 event is going on in Japan .
author: ComicBook

title: 26 Years Later, Long-Running Series Confirms Final Battle
content: After eight long years, one of CLAMP’s most popular manga series finally returns to the page. CLAMP is an all-female manga group whom worked on several high-profile manga and anime series since the 1990s. The group’s work often varies and changes genre from project to project.
author: ComicBook

title: Studio Ghibli Veterans’ Most Underrated Film Gets Surprise Screening in The US
content: Studio Ghibli has yet to release information regarding the next project that the production house will work on, following the smash success of The Boy And The Heron . Despite this fact, animators who got their start with Hayao Miyazaki’s company are working hard in the anime medium to this day.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Major Isekai Gets a New Update Ahead of Sequel
content: The exciting Spring 2026 anime season is finally here, and Netflix is bringing a new list of series to the platform. The streaming giant kicked off the year with some of the most gorgeous and exciting anime of all time, including Cosmic Princess Kaguya and Love Through a Prism .
author: ComicBook

title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2's 3rd English-Subtitled Trailer Unveils Ending Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Kōcha Agasawa 's romantic comedy manga You and I Are Polar Opposites ( Seihantaina Kimi to Boku ) presented the second season's third trailer with English subtitles on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Witch Hat Atelier Used as Many as '20,000 Drawings' in Episode 5, Revealing Anime Staff's Stark Effort
content: Witch Hat Atelier star Rena Motomura (Coco) revealed that the anime’s fifth episode took as many as 20,000 drawings to produce. She shared this in her appearance on SHIBUYA ANIME BASE Episode 88, which aired on June 12.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump’s Anime Revival Reveals First Official Trailer
content: Weekly Shonen Jump ‘s gag humor manga, Super Psychic Policeman Chojo , by Shun Numa, was axed in June this year, leading to a rushed ending. The manga debuted in February last year and reached its conclusion in Chapter 64, releasing eight volumes later.
author: ComicBook

title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Ending Theme by Mega Shinnosuke
content: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2 anime revealed the third trailer, introducing the ending theme song “You are the one” by Mega Shinnosuke. The second season was announced on March 29, and it is set to premiere on July 5, 2026. Studio Lapin Track ( Undead Girl Murder Farce ) is animating.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen’s Culling Game Gets a Major Streaming Update After Finale
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is all set for a major update this month during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary. The third season of the anime follows the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident Arc before commencing the intense Culling Game. As the longest arc of the series, it will be adapted into two anime seasons.
author: ComicBook
